## Summary

- Added `ComplianceRuleSeverity` and `ComplianceCheckStatus`.
- Added `ComplianceRule` and `ComplianceCheck` persistence plus review task compliance fields.
- Added Alembic `20260507_0005_compliance_gate`.
- Added `content_factory_api.modules.compliance`:
  - seeded deterministic MVP rules;
  - check execution/list/rerun endpoints;
  - latest/final compliance decision helpers;
  - hard-fail blocking and soft-flag override enforcement.
- `submit-review` now runs and links a compliance check.
- `approve` now requires latest check, blocks hard fails, and requires override reason for soft flags.
- API export create/retry and worker package processing now verify final compliance decision.
- Web cockpit now fetches compliance checks, shows review summaries/flags, supports rerun, and filters export candidates.
- OpenAPI and generated TS contracts include compliance schemas/routes and review override fields.
